<div class="case-study-section">

<div class="section-label">ABOUT THE PROJECT</div>

<h2 class="case-study-title">Revisiting a franchise isn't enough.</h2>

<p>
This entertainment marketing project examines the strategy behind legacy sequels: films that return to established franchises years or decades after the original.
</p>

<p>
Using <em>Top Gun: Maverick</em> as a major example, I explored how nostalgia can attract existing fans while a film still needs to provide something new for modern audiences.
</p>

<p>
The project also compares other franchise revivals to identify how audience expectations, returning characters, branding, and marketing can influence reception.
</p>

</div>
